mir.text: Garth arrives in Kush and is drawn into its culture of magical duels, allying with the old thief Hammen and earning the name One-Eye in a public duel.

Zarel captures and tortures Garth, but Hammen, Norreen and Varena free him, and Garth reveals he is a survivor of the destroyed Fifth House and the son of its slain leader and enters the Arena under the lost House's banner.

Zarel and Kuthuman declare the final battles deathmatches to ensure his demise, and Garth is forced to kill Varena in a duel, but he wins the tournament and wounds Kuthuman when the Planeswalker tries to kill him.
Garth returns and drives a dagger into Zarel's heart, ending his tyranny, and he and Norreen later defeat Kuthuman and seal his portal before retiring to raise their child.
